claim: A Blood foe wakes when it can see the player: aiLookForTarget (run only when a roll on the foe's alertChance passes) asks cansee between the two, then wakes the foe if the player is within its seeDist and periphery angle, or within its hearDist. cansee passes from sector to sector through portals; walls and steps stop it, sprites do not. So a foe with a clear line to the start, near enough and facing it, wakes within moments of the level beginning.
evidence: NBlood/source/blood/src/ai.cpp:1331-1365 aiLookForTarget: Chance(alertChance), cansee(...) at :1351, seeDist and periphery at :1354, hearDist at :1360
the owner, 2026-11-25: 'right now you just get attacked by a lot of enemies around you immediatelly'; ten foes saw Gravesend's start
use: Measure who sees the start and the first steps with first_sight.py; hide the start with SECTORS (boards, a ride's drum, a stall's back), because a sprite blocks no line.
